item.title: Aircraft Incident, Storr Funeral, Boating Fees Rebound
item.ns0:title: Aircraft Incident, Storr Funeral, Boating Fees Rebound
item.description:
Tonight on Our News Weekend, we bring you the latest on a frightening aircraft incident in North Bimini where a seaplane with ten people on board became immobilized during taxiing. We follow the emotional final farewell for a beloved musician lost in the tragic Independence Day plane crash and provide critical updates on the death of a shooting victim and a heartbreaking drowning. As BPL struggles with a power grid near capacity, we investigate the impact of fresh outages on local businesses while also exploring a major economic rebound for Bimini’s marinas. Plus, catch the highlights from the basketball court as the Arkansas Razorbacks take on Team Bahamas and see how new training initiatives are opening doors for residents with disabilities.
